snapshot.text: Compulsory health insurance through the national fund ZZZS. A new health minister took office in June 2026 and stresses prevention, access to care and managing the system on data; the future of smaller regional hospitals is a recurring issue.

priorities.title: Prevention and accessible care
priorities.text: In talks with EU Commissioner Várhelyi the minister put prevention and accessible healthcare first.

priorities.title: Data-driven management
priorities.text: The minister says the health system must be managed on the basis of data.

priorities.title: Keeping regional hospitals
priorities.text: The ministry has committed to keeping Slovenj Gradec hospital.
